scene.note: The hut's notices, log and till file are read, written and counted from disk, each in its own character set.

steps.note: A file is named by its path, and read as a list of its lines, whatever line ends it has.
The old till's file is read in the character set the till wrote it in, so its pound signs come through.
A file that is not there is not an empty answer: whoever asked is told.
A board is saved as a file of its own lines, each ending the same way on every computer.
A line is added to the end of the log, and what the log held stays.
A file that is not there yet is made the first time.
The till's file is read a line at a time, however long it grows.
The lines that name a boat are counted, and the file is closed once the count is done.
When there is no till file yet, the count is nothing at all.
